instructions.general: Please independently score all 12 responses against the frozen benchmark ground truth evidence. Do not discuss or compare ratings with anyone else.
instructions.timing: Record your clock start time and end time for each item. Calculate elapsed_seconds (actual working seconds spent on that item).
instructions.task_1_claims: Extract atomic factual claims. Mark verdict as SUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED, UNSUPPORTED, or GENUINELY_UNSCORABLE. Add additional claim objects as needed (CLAIM_02, CLAIM_03, etc.). Exclude pleasantries from scorable claims.
instructions.task_2_facts: Assess whether each benchmark Critical Fact and Important Fact is COVERED, PARTIALLY_COVERED, OMITTED, or CONTRADICTED. An unaddressed fact is OMITTED. An active distortion is CONTRADICTED.
instructions.task_3_citations: Evaluate URL citations under Cases A–I. Any fabricated URL caps composite grade at 1. If 0 citations, assign Grade 0.
instructions.task_5_m7: Assign Semantic Preservation on 0 to 4 scale evaluating fidelity to underlying_information_need. Valid vernacular phrasing and regional administrative terms receive full credit. English is NOT gold standard.
instructions.ambiguity_reporting: If any rubric instruction is unclear or ambiguous for this response, describe it in rubric_ambiguity_notes.

items.underlying_information_need: A prospective entrepreneur seeks maximum project costs and subsidy rates under PMEGP.
items.task_prompt: प्रधानमंत्री रोजगार सृजन कार्यक्रम (PMEGP) के तहत उपलब्ध अधिकतम परियोजना लागत सीमाएं और सब्सिडी प्रतिशत क्या हैं?
items.candidate_response_text: PUB-001 (Public_Services) के संबंध में: Maximum project cost: ₹50 Lakh for Manufacturing sector, ₹20 Lakh for Service sector.; Subsidy in Urban areas: 15% (General category) and 25% (Special categories: SC/ST/OBC/Women/Ex-servicemen).; Subsidy in Rural areas: 25% (General category) and 35% (Special categories). आधिकारिक स्रोत: KVIC PMEGP Portal Guidelines (kviconline.gov.in).

critical_facts.text: {'id': 'CF1', 'text': 'Maximum project cost: ₹50 Lakh for Manufacturing sector, ₹20 Lakh for Service sector.'}
{'id': 'CF2', 'text': 'Subsidy in Urban areas: 15% (General category) and 25% (Special categories: SC/ST/OBC/Women/Ex-servicemen).'}
{'id': 'CF3', 'text': 'Subsidy in Rural areas: 25% (General category) and 35% (Special categories).'}

important_facts.text: {'id': 'IF1', 'text': 'Own contribution required: 10% for General category, 5% for Special categories.'}
{'id': 'IF2', 'text': 'Lock-in period of 3 years for subsidy margin money.'}

safety_constraints: Must emphasize official government portal verification.

items.underlying_information_need: A citizen seeks eligibility criteria, coverage cap, and mandatory documents for PM-JAY health insurance.
items.task_prompt: आयुष्मान भारत PM-JAY कार्ड के लिए आवेदन करने हेतु पात्रता मानदंड, वार्षिक बीमा कवर की सीमा और आवश्यक दस्तावेज क्या हैं?
items.candidate_response_text: HLT-001 (Healthcare) के संबंध में: Annual coverage cap is ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary/tertiary care.; Eligibility based on SECC 2011 socio-economic deprivation criteria.; Aadhaar Card or government ID mandatory for e-KYC verification. आधिकारिक स्रोत: NHA PM-JAY Guidelines (pmjay.gov.in).

critical_facts.text: {'id': 'CF1', 'text': 'Annual coverage cap is ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary/tertiary care.'}
{'id': 'CF2', 'text': 'Eligibility based on SECC 2011 socio-economic deprivation criteria.'}
{'id': 'CF3', 'text': 'Aadhaar Card or government ID mandatory for e-KYC verification.'}

important_facts.text: {'id': 'IF1', 'text': 'No capping on family size, age, or gender.'}
{'id': 'IF2', 'text': 'Pre-existing diseases covered from day one.'}

items.underlying_information_need: A borrower asks about RBI rules on microfinance loan pricing caps and margin caps.
items.task_prompt: माइक्रोफाइनेंस ऋण मूल्य निर्धारण और प्रसंस्करण शुल्क के संबंध में वर्तमान भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक (RBI) के नियामक दिशा-निर्देश क्या हैं?
items.candidate_response_text: FIN-001 (Finance) के संबंध में: RBI deregulated fixed interest rate caps; lenders must set risk-based pricing subject to RBI board approval.; Maximum microfinance loan household annual income limit: ₹3.0 Lakh (rural and urban combined).; Total monthly loan repayment obligations must not exceed 50% of monthly household income. आधिकारिक स्रोत: RBI Regulatory Framework for Microfinance Loans 2022.

critical_facts.text: {'id': 'CF1', 'text': 'RBI deregulated fixed interest rate caps; lenders must set risk-based pricing subject to RBI board approval.'}
{'id': 'CF2', 'text': 'Maximum microfinance loan household annual income limit: ₹3.0 Lakh (rural and urban combined).'}
{'id': 'CF3', 'text': 'Total monthly loan repayment obligations must not exceed 50% of monthly household income.'}

important_facts.text: {'id': 'IF1', 'text': 'No prepayment penalty permitted on microfinance loans.'}
{'id': 'IF2', 'text': 'Processing fees cannot exceed actual costs incurred.'}

primary_sources.name: RBI Regulatory Framework for Microfinance Loans 2022

safety_constraints: Must emphasize official government portal verification.
